exposure: Vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGF-A) protein expression in FGR placentas
outcome: Early neonatal morphological brain evaluation by ultrasound (UZV)
Functional evaluation of neurological status by Amiel - Tison Neurological Assessment at Term (ATNAT)
cohort: Neonates born from 50 FGR-complicated pregnancies and 30 uneventful pregnancies.
finding: No statistically significant correlation was found between placental VEGF-A expression levels and early neurological deficits in neonates.
cross-section timing: Post-delivery, at term or term-equivalent for neurological assessment
gest_age: Assessed at term or term-equivalent for neurological assessment
